_comment: Geographic routing is most-specific-first: county → state → multi-state. Initial coverage covers the top ~15 US metros at the county level; non-metro contacts fall through to state-level. Source kinds: QUERY_TEMPLATE (per-name URL), ROSTER_PAGE (static, used only with strict name match), MANUAL_LANDING (user-only, never automated evidence). When in doubt about a URL pattern, ship as MANUAL_LANDING so the auto scraper never produces false confidence.

_multi_state_obituary_comment: National news search. Google News indexes local papers, TV stations, Legacy.com, Dignity Memorial and funeral-home obituaries, so one query per contact reaches death and arrest reports no single roster carries. Each item is classified (death vs arrest) and read by NewsFeed; MatchVerifier scores it before anything is shown. evidence_url_template is the bare host so item links (news.google.com/rss/articles/...) pass SourceCatalog.isFromCatalog.
_identity_sources_comment: Identity-correlation services (face recognition, reverse image search, name-based OSINT) ported from the sister project doxray (github.com/HereLiesAz/doxray). All entries ship as MANUAL_LANDING because (a) the face/image services require a photo upload the Registry never carries, and (b) the name-based services (PimEyes, FaceCheck.id, CyberBackgroundChecks, SmartBackgroundChecks, GitHub) bot-block raw HTTP requests — they must be exercised through the user's own browser session. The CyberBackgroundChecks / SmartBackgroundChecks chips use the same /name/{first}-{last} search path that the enrichment flow (util/CyberBackgroundChecks.kt) produces, so the chip and the auto-enricher land on the same page (previously the chip used a /people/ path that did not match). Templates with {first}/{last} slots are filled at chip-render time via SourceUrlBuilder.
